instruction.text: Lana uses a measuring container to measure the amount of orange juice left in her fridge. How many litres of orange juice are in the container?

atoms.b: There are <mat><gap>8</gap></mat> litres of orange juice in the measuring container.

instruction.text: Lana swaps her measuring container to a smaller one that uses millilitres. How many millilitres of lemonade are in the container?

atoms.b: There are <mat><gap>175</gap></mat> ml of lemonade in the measuring container.
atoms.sound: There are 175 millilitres of lemonade in the measuring container.

instruction.text: Marley is conducting an experiment and has to pour different quantities into his beaker. Select the correct amount on the beaker.
Suri has 800 ml of water in her water bottle. She drinks 300 ml. She thinks that she is left with 600 ml, is she correct?
Varsha is collecting rainwater. Last week, she collected 4 l of water and, this week, she collected 9 l. She thinks that she collected 5 l more water this week than last week, is she correct?
